set.body:
Scope
Make mathematical contracts executable across every implementation path.

Acceptance criteria
- Analytic diagonal, 2x2 Laplacian, soft-threshold, tiny fused-lasso, and singular-nullspace fixtures exist.
- Differential tests use an independent convex implementation and published Allen/GMD/GLRM limiting cases; LowRankModels.jl is never the sole oracle.
- Metamorphic tests cover permutation/relabeling, scaling, coordinate changes, zero/large penalties, and sparse/dense equivalence.
- Mutation tests breaking adjoints, norm bounds, proximal laws, masks, or fold provenance fail for the intended reason.
- Objective/rate/residual trajectories are tested, not only final values.
- Deterministic seeds and conditioning-aware tolerances are recorded.
- PR-fast, reference, and nightly stress/performance tiers are documented.
- JVM and JS agree within declared tolerances without hidden densification.
set.title: Multivar math 7: independent oracle, adversarial, and performance matrix
